name: com.innov8tif.okayid.BaseCameraActivity
description: OkayID Mobile (Innov8tif identity-document SDK) uses this shared camera Activity beneath its document-capture screen. It handles camera permission, preview, focus and still-photo capture for that screen.
disableEffect: It has no separate camera screen, so disabling this entry does not remove those functions from the actual OkayID Mobile capture screen.
